status_note: Reserved so the effector loader, the deck resolver and the simulator already dispatch on kind. Every numeric field below is a placeholder and MUST be measured before this file is used to generate motion. lab.effector refuses to load a placeholder unless allow_placeholder=True.

actuator.note: If the gripper is driven by the same ACTUATOR_MOVE macro, these are POS values on that axis. If it gets its own macro, add a macro_name field here and the loader will use it instead.

carries_labware_note: Unlike a pipette the gripper changes the deck LAYOUT at runtime: picking a plate empties a slot and fills the effector. lab.layout tracks this so the simulator can catch a move into a slot the gripper just emptied, or a place into an occupied one.
